parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ match_id: $('Read match').first().json.match.match_id, part: $('Which report').first().json.part === 'half' ? 'half' : 'full', audience: $env.RECAP_AUDIENCE || 'coach', language: $env.RECAP_LANGUAGE || 'en' }) }}

parameters.content:
## Brighton · reports
At half time the ingest service posts `POST /webhook/brighton/half-time`; `HALFTIME_DELAY` seconds later (default 60, so the analyst can make the last calls) the half-time report goes to `STAFF_EMAIL_TO`: the plan's targets in the first half, the deviations with the analyst's calls and notes, the numbers and the key plays, the narrator agent's story of the half (`RECAP_LANGUAGE`, `RECAP_AUDIENCE`), with a button to the printable report. At full time (`/full-time`), `REPORT_DELAY` seconds later (default 300), the match report goes to `REPORT_EMAIL_TO`. Both attach a CSV of every target in every 5 minutes.

`GET /webhook/brighton/report?match_id=…&part=half|full` sends one now (default: the match being played, or the latest).

description: Emails the staff the half-time report and the coaching staff the match report.
